goal: Build multidimensional senior-year trajectory analysis for students, parents and teacher-facing shares without turning the product into a generic score table.
productPrinciple: 再回到具体考试和分数核对
comparisonRules: 趋势先按考试类别判断是否可比，类别不一致不进入同一趋势结论。
月考只与月考比较，不与联考或校考合并。
联考与校考属于同一可比类别，可以合并观察。
一模、二模、三模统一归入模考类别。
同一类别内若至少有两次同考试系列记录，可优先使用该系列；否则回到类别级比较。
单科历史展示保留所有考试；可比类别只决定哪些考试进入趋势判断，不隐藏其他历史考试。
联考支持独立联考位次及可选联考人数；不知道人数时只保留位次，不伪造百分位。
联考与校考合并趋势时，只比较两边共有且口径一致的学校/班级位置，不能拿联考位次和校排名直接混算。
nonGoals: No high-stakes prediction of Gaokao score or admission outcome.
No radar chart as the primary comparison UI.
No teacher account system in v0.3.0; teacher use is a privacy-scoped share preset.
No third-party analytics or new paid storage dependency.

stages.name: release gate
acceptance: Version is 0.3.0 across package, lockfile and Worker APP_VERSION.
npm run verify passes on the final PR head after this checkpoint commit.
Regression tests cover rank-only data, category-gated trend comparison, joint rank, multi-exam subject comparison, sharing privacy, Android-friendly interaction and observer safety.
PR is merged only with expected_head_sha after final CI is green.
Cloudflare deploy checks out the exact tested SHA.
Production /api/health attests appVersion=0.3.0 before declaring complete.

restartProtocol: 1. Fetch current main SHA and PR #12 head; never assume chat-state is current.
2. Read this checkpoint and PR body completely.
3. Inspect PR changed files/diff and latest CI before changing code.
4. Treat only committed code + passing tests as completed; never mark a stage complete from prose alone.
5. Resume the first stage whose status is not completed, preserving already-committed work.
6. If main advanced, compare/reconcile deliberately; do not force-reset the feature branch.
7. Do not merge until final-head CI is green; then use expected_head_sha and verify main plus production health.
